label_contract.note: Rows are a deterministic state-coverage sample. Inclusion probabilities and weights are null; do not use these rows to estimate population rates.

sampling.design: overdraw global matching, observed PyBullet outcome split, paired-control seed, then observed-state swaps on the reported mean-nearest-neighbour objective

swap_optimizer.semantic_constraint: no accepted swap reduces unique items or unique item-orientations among observed rows
swap_optimizer.contract: Monotone local search on the reported paired delta from the control seed. It does not prove global optimality and does not guarantee a positive delta.
